sb_prompt: FIND OUT THE OTHER CALLERS' PREFERENCE AND LEVEL OF INTEREST IN PERSONAL COMPUTERS.  HOW DOES IT COMPARE TO YOUR INTEREST AND PREFERENCE?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hey there!
ParticipantA: You sound busy, are you in the middle of something?
ParticipantB: A little bit, just checking a table before I go back to the kitchen.
ParticipantA: Oh, wait for me, I'm pretty free actually.
ParticipantB: Okay, cool. So, what's up?
ParticipantA: Well, my mom sent me a link about some new AI art thing and I was like, "Hey, tell this stranger on the phone about computers!"
ParticipantB: LMAO, funny! That's actually why you called me?
ParticipantA: Exactly! I gotta be honest, computers are kinda intimidating to me. I have some college but mostly I just use them to do my bank deposits.
ParticipantB: Oh wow, really? I thought you'd be the tech expert!
ParticipantA: Ha, no way! My cousin is the one who actually built my PC last year. I just tell him what I want and he does the rest.
ParticipantB: Oh man, that's kinda cool. I have a personal experience with this actually.
ParticipantA: Do tell!
ParticipantB: Yeah, last summer my laptop died right before a big trip. I had to go to a store and beg someone to help me fix it, and it was such a pain.
ParticipantA: Oh no, that sounds awful! I'm lucky I didn't have to deal with that kind of stress.
ParticipantB: Yeah, but seeing them troubleshoot it got me interested. I've been trying to learn a little more about how they work ever since.
ParticipantA: That's cool! So, do you prefer working with the actual machines or just using them?
ParticipantB: Honestly, I love the machines. Sometimes I just like taking them apart to see how the fans spin. But mostly I just use them to manage my schedules.
ParticipantA: Same here! I love watching the screens light up when the teller line works. It's satisfying when it's all connected right.
ParticipantB: Yeah, there's something nice about knowing everything is working perfectly.
ParticipantA: Totally. Do you ever feel like computers are getting too complicated though?
ParticipantB: All the time! Like, why do they need ten updates for a simple thing?
ParticipantA: Right? It feels like they want to force you to learn all this new stuff.
ParticipantB: Exactly, it feels like a chore sometimes.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I think I'll stick to what I know until I figure out how to update without messing up my banking app.
ParticipantB: Good plan, trust your cousin for the heavy lifting!
ParticipantA: Haha, I will!
ParticipantB: Anyway, I think I've got a rush coming up, gotta get back to work.
ParticipantA: Okay, well thanks for talking about computers with me!
ParticipantB: You too, it was fun!
ParticipantA: Bye!
ParticipantB: Bye!
